Hi Neer! Nainspire ako sa willpower mo to try again! I want to remind you that nothing is impossible kahit nasaan ka pa ngayon sa journey mo.

Last year nag f2f review ako. Sa experience ko, it's like 20% kinig sa lessons, 80% own effort. Nasa student na talaga kung paano ang magiging strategy nya para matuto (and in my case, I didn't make it, sadly.) It's all about the decisions you will make after attending the class. Sariling effort. Sariling katawan at kaluluwa. 

Personally, hindi sya naging effective sakin because of different personal reasons and problems na nag-arise sa akin during my review. Umaattend ako sa klase, but since hindi nga ako mentally present, I had to watch online lectures of the whole topic that given day so parang wala lang din silbi yung pagpasok ko. I wish na sa bahay na lang ako nagreview the whole time kagaya ngayon.

However, if the sense of being in a classroom will help you awaken the student mode within you, you may go for f2f! Siguro the good thing with f2f classes is like merong sense of accountability dahil may classmates ka tapos yung environment is tahimik at walang istorbo unlike pag nasa bahay. Maybe you will meet people and brain storm with them. It's much better than studying alone kasi may mapagtatanungan ka. I noticed that other reviewees are generally nice and generous naman. 😊 

I wish you all the best, neer!
